name: Overturn Health and Human Services rule: Restoring Flexibility in the Child Care and Development Fund (CCDF)
official: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Department of Health and Human Services relating to "Restoring Flexibility in the Child Care and Development Fund (CCDF)".
